name: archdiff-vscode
description: The architecture of the repository beside the editor: archdiff's page in a panel, the picture of this file or this function, and the contract check as problems

untrustedWorkspaces.description: archdiff runs the archdiff command the workspace installed (node_modules/.bin/archdiff) or names in its settings.

virtualWorkspaces.description: archdiff reads the files of the repository from the disk.

archdiff.command.markdownDescription: The archdiff to run: a path (relative to the workspace folder, or absolute) or a name on the PATH. Empty: the one the workspace installed (`node_modules/.bin/archdiff`), else the one on the PATH, else `npx --yes @ivlad003/archdiff`.

archdiff.checkOnSave.markdownDescription: Run `archdiff check --json` when a file is saved, in a folder that has an `ARCHITECTURE.md` and an archdiff installed, and show every import against the contract as a problem on its line.

enumDescriptions: What the function calls, step by step, and where the trail ends
In what order the function's calls cross the modules
Which calls lead from the function to a store
Everything joined to the function: what calls it and what it calls
The function's body as a flowchart, with its paths as rules
archdiff.functionView.markdownDescription: The view *Show this function* opens for the function under the cursor.

archdiff.embed.markdownDescription: Show the picture alone, without the page's header and side panels (`?embed=1`).

scripts.test: node --test tests/command.test.ts tests/views.test.ts tests/diagnostics.test.ts tests/panel.test.ts tests/runner.test.ts
